summary: Iteration 7 validates the 4-module integration spec (Produksi SMT & ASSY PRODUCT filter + totals, Stock SMT PRODUCT+standard+indikator, Kebutuhan Assy VS. Stock SMT read-only view, Variance Stock read-only view) plus PRODUCT filter across dashboard. Backend pytest 18/18 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter7_integrations.py, junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter7_results.xml). Verified with seed test data (ics=9900000001, lane=ZZ9, product=REGULER, type='UJI SPEC'): (a) POST /api/items with tt_assy=36, material_per_unit=1 → stored; (b) POST /api/stock-standards {REGULER,ZZ9,100} succeeds and second POST returns 409 DUPLICATE; (c) GET /api/smt-stock?ics_no=9900000001 → 10-01 total 100 std 100 indikator PASS, 10-02 80 MINUS, 10-03 120 OVER; records for other ICS without standard return 'BELUM DISET'; ?status=OVER filter returns only OVER; (d) GET /api/production-needs?ics_no=9900000001 → 2026-10-05 kondisi_produksi ON, stock_ok_today=600, tt_assy=36, material_per_unit=1, waktu_shortage=6.0 jam, plan_assy=100, blc=500, status CUKUP. PUT production planing_smt=0,plan_assy=0 → kondisi_produksi OFF, waktu_shortage=null; restore keeps 6.0; PUT stock ok=300 → waktu_shortage 3.0; PUT items tt_assy=72 → 6.0; restore ok=600 & tt_assy=36 → 6.0; (e) GET /api/variance?ics_no=9900000001 → 10-01 status BELUM DICEK, prev None; 10-02 prev=100 sistem=100 actual=80 variance=-20 status 'VARIANCE -'; 10-03 prev=80 sistem=80 actual=120 variance=+40 'VARIANCE +'; 10-05 prev=120 smt_total=90 assy_total=100 sistem=110 actual=600 variance=490. PUT act_smt_s1=190 → smt_total 190 sistem 210; PUT act_assy_s1=300 → assy_total 300 sistem 10; PUT stock ok=10 → variance=0 status OK. (f) product filter: /api/smt-production?product=SPO, /api/smt-stock?product=SPO, /api/production-needs?product=SPO, /api/variance?product=SPO all return only product==SPO rows; /api/meta/options returns both REGULER and SPO; /api/dashboard/summary?product=SPO kpi.smt_items <= without filter. (g) smt user (smt/password123) GET /api/production-needs & /api/variance → 200; POST /api/stock-standards → 403 (falls back to items=read → stock_standards=read). (h) Existing data preservation: counts prior 178 smt_production/207 smt_stock/109 items unchanged after full test cycle. Frontend (Playwright on https://data-stock-branch.preview.emergentagent.com): admin login OK; nav-production-needs text = 'Kebutuhan Assy VS. Stock SMT'; nav-stock-standards text = 'Standar Stock'. Produksi SMT & ASSY: filter-product exists with options ['ALL PRODUCT','REGULER','SPO']; selecting SPO reduces TOTAL row from 178 to 51 rows and all visible Product column cells = 'SPO'; reset to ALL PRODUCT restores. Stock SMT headers include 'Total Stock Hari Ini','Standart Stock','Indikator' with Product column after Lane; filter-product and filter-status (Indikator) both present. Kebutuhan headers include 'Kondisi Produksi','Stock OK Hari Ini','T/T Assy (dtk/unit)','Waktu Shortage' — NO add-record-button, NO import-open-button, NO 'Diinput oleh'/'Waktu Input'/'Aksi' columns; searching '9900000001' shows row '2026-10-05 ZZ9 REGULER UJI SPEC ... 6 jam ... CUKUP'. Variance headers 'Total Produksi SMT','Total Produksi Assy','Stock System','Stock Actual','Status Variance'; no 'Keterangan'/'Aksi'/'Diinput oleh'; badge 'VARIANCE -' & 'VARIANCE +' visible on searched test rows. Standar Stock page: add-record-button present for admin; dialog opens with Product (REGULER select), Lane (ZZ9 select), Standart Stock (pcs); form filled successfully (visible in screenshot). Dashboard: dash-product select present, ALL PRODUCT is default, selecting SPO reloads KPI without console errors. SMT user: nav-stock-standards visible (read), no Tambah/Add button rendered (write blocked in UI + backend 403 confirmed). All test data (ics 9900000001, stock-standard ZZ9) removed at end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1282 lines — still needs modular split (auth, crud, integrations, dashboard, import, backup). This is repeated from iter 6.
needs_view and variance_view perform per-date find + client-side merges; add compound indexes on smt_stock/smt_production (date, ics_no, type) for scalability.

meta_options() unions 'products' from items and smt_production only — smt_stock/production_needs/variance products (from fill_product) are not exposed there, but current usage is fine because product source of truth is Master Item.
Duplicate detection for stock-standards uses cfg['key']=['product','lane']; the DB has no unique index on (product,lane) so two concurrent POSTs could race. Add unique compound index.
compute_variance still writes to legacy 'stock_sistem'/'variance_pct' fields on the raw doc even though variance_view recomputes them read-only. Harmless but dead code.
link_stock_prev runs prev_stock lookup per doc (O(N) queries on each GET /smt-stock). Batching by ics/type would cut latency for large datasets.
backup_restore performs delete_many + insert_many without transaction — partial failure leaves module empty (noted iter 6, not addressed).
readOnly CrudPage still shows 'Export' CSV button — fine, but note it exports the enriched read-only view including sistem/variance derived cols.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (nav labels, product filter with totals refresh, headers per module, read-only Needs/Variance, waktu shortage jam, variance badges, Standar Stock add dialog, dashboard product filter, smt permission)

seed_data_creation: Test rows for ics 9900000001 (items, 4 smt_stock 2026-10-01..05, 1 smt_production 2026-10-05) and stock-standard {REGULER,ZZ9,100} created during tests and DELETED at end. Existing seed (178 smt_production / 207 smt_stock / 109 items) verified intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suites now include test_iter7_integrations.py. Frontend test IDs: nav-production-needs, nav-stock-standards, filter-product (with 'ALL PRODUCT' option), filter-status (Indikator), table-totals footer row, add-record-button, import-open-button, dash-product. Needs & Variance are read-only (readOnly + hideAudit props); RecordDialog submit button testid is 'record-submit'. Waktu Shortage column renders '{n} jam' (type='hours' in CrudPage renderCell). Standard stock POST duplicate returns 409 with detail.code='DUPLICATE'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All spec-mandated behaviours were verified end-to-end.
